13:00.race_name: William Hill Racing Epic Boosts Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)

runners.comment: Flopped on penultimate start but progressive and unbeaten otherwise; 2-2 at Newbury
runners.name: Sober Glory
runners.spotlight: Acts on soft ground; flopped at Sandown returned to Listed level but progressive and unbeaten otherwise; rebounded in emphatic fashion over C&D last time, taking Newbury record to 2-2; easily beat Kadastral at Chepstow in the autumn; leading contender, even with a 10lb penalty.

runners.comment: C&D win last time took his Newbury record to 2-2; open to plenty of further improvement
runners.name: Kadastral
runners.spotlight: No match for Sober Glory at Chepstow but may well prove a bigger threat in this rematch, being still open to plenty of further improvement; like that rival he's 2-2 at Newbury, having won a valuable bumper (good) last March and C&D maiden hurdle (good to soft) latest start; respected.

runners.breeder: A Peltier D Juste & J Houdin
runners.comment: Has frame possibilities but likely needs further progress to double his tally
runners.name: Kocktail Bleu
runners.spotlight: Failed to get home over 2m4f at Newbury when bidding to follow up his reappearance win; ran well dropped back in trip at Kempton (2m, good) and has frame possibilities in this field; however, likely needs further progress to double his tally.

runners.comment: Likely to find better opportunities in handicaps shortly
runners.name: Air Apparent
runners.owner: A Cocks T Johnson & P Downing
runners.spotlight: Has shown a bit of promise in both starts but the bare form suggests he'll find better opportunities in handicaps shortly; modest fourth at Wincanton (1m7f) latest.

runners.comment: No promise in two attempts over hurdles
runners.name: Famous Shoes
runners.spotlight: No promise in two attempts over hurdles, behind when late faller latest; had wind surgery since.

runners.comment: Has finished last in two C&D events for new yard
runners.name: Gulf Coast Highway
runners.spotlight: Made the frame in Irish bumper but has finished last in a couple of C&D events for new yard; very weak claims.

runners.comment: May improve, with this further drop in distance worth exploring
runners.name: Last Round
runners.spotlight: Appeared to stay 3m on second attempt in Irish points but raced freely and failed to get home over 2m5f at Ludlow on the switch to rules; may improve, with this further drop in distance worth exploring.

runners.comment: Has made a consistent start to his career but this looks a stiff task
runners.name: Typhoon Warrior
runners.spotlight: Has made the frame in two bumpers and a Market Rasen novice hurdle (2m2f) for a consistent start to his career; however, has a lot to find on bare figures and yard holds a much stronger chance with Kadastral.

runners.comment: Progressive on Flat for Andrew Balding and bagged Listed honours on last appearance
runners.name: Fantasy World
runners.spotlight: Progressive on the Flat for Andrew Balding and bagged Listed honours at Ascot (1m6f, good to soft) on last appearance; sold for 600,000gns later in October; already towards the top of the betting for the Triumph and looks a very interesting hurdles prospect.

runners.comment: Failed to make much of a splash over C&D on hurdles debut
runners.name: Laplander
runners.owner: A Lofts C & R Russell & Partner
runners.spotlight: Inconsistent maiden on Flat and failed to make much of a splash in C&D juvenile hurdle last time; opposed.

13:35.race_name: William Hill Each Way Extra Handicap Hurdle (Challenger Stayers' Hurdle Series Qualifier)

runners.comment: £35,000 buy last May and had a remote finish at Worcester in July on his only start since
runners.name: Might I
runners.spotlight: Acts on heavy; useful for Harry Fry but became inconsistent and has never won a handicap; bought for £35,000 last May and had a remote finish at Worcester in July on his only start since; has career-low mark but plenty to prove, including stamina on this fourth attempt at about 3m.

runners.comment: Needs to bounce back from a poor show at Haydock three weeks ago; player if he does
runners.name: Kyntara
runners.spotlight: Highly progressive staying hurdler in the 2023-24 campaign, including on heavy ground, and chasing didn't work out for him last season; ran pretty well over hurdles on first two starts this term but needs to bounce back from a poor show at Haydock three weeks ago; player if he does.

runners.comment: Acts on heavy and well handicapped, but something to prove at present, including at 3m
runners.name: Crebilly
runners.spotlight: Acts on heavy and well handicapped on lots of form, mostly over fences; patchy campaign last term, when jumping fences seemed to be holding him back, and made a respectable return to hurdling in November but then flopped at Chepstow (ground seemed good rather than the official good to soft) six weeks ago; those last two runs were at about 3m and stamina is still not proven.

runners.comment: 1st and 2nd in 2m5f handicaps; dam won at up to 3m and he now looks worth a go at it
runners.name: A Pai De Nom
runners.owner: Cherry Knoll Farm M Ward & D Skelton
runners.spotlight: 3-5 hurdling, notably when winning an 18-runner race at Cheltenham (2m5f, soft) in November on handicap debut; novice winner next time and creditable third of 15 when favourite for the Lanzarote Handicap at Kempton (2m5f, good) latest start; dam won at up to 3m and he now looks worth a go at it.

runners.comment: Disappointing this season and connections ring the changes in a major way
runners.name: Kapal Layar
runners.spotlight: Ended last term with maiden (on soft) and handicap wins, latterly at Perth (2m4f, good to soft) in April; disappointing on both starts this term but was struck into last time and has also since had wind surgery; additionally, he's now upped in trip and has tongue-tie and cheekpieces for the first time, so there could be explanations aplenty were he to stage a revival.

runners.comment: Stamina has not been proved after two attempts at 2m7f; ran well over 2m5f on latest start
runners.name: Below The Radar
runners.spotlight: Stamina has not been proved after two attempts at 2m7f, albeit latterly when a mid-race faller on chase debut in December; good second of 17 back over hurdles at Haydock (2m5f, good to soft; acts on heavy) three weeks ago under Freddie Keighley and there is some stamina in the family.

runners.comment: Stays well; best effort on good to soft; out of form when he was last seen 484 days ago
runners.name: Goshhowposh
runners.spotlight: Pulled up sole start on heavy; won off this mark in a Pertemps qualifier at Wincanton (3m, good to soft) on Boxing Day 2023 but did not live up to that in his three races in 2024, in headgear on last two occasions; absent 484 days since, so assessing his revival prospects requires some guesswork.

runners.comment: Mixed messages, including with proven stamina but a question over effectiveness in the mud
runners.name: Tranquil Sea
runners.spotlight: Usually ran in the mud in his Irish days but better when he won at Chepstow (3m, good) in October for new stable; hard work over C&D next time, which preceded wind surgery; ran creditably on next two outings but his form then dipped again on soft at Windsor three weeks ago; mixed messages.

runners.comment: French hurdle winner on heavy; poor chase debut for new yard last month after long layoff
runners.name: Alentejo
runners.owner: Mr And Mrs J D Cotton
runners.spotlight: 3-12 over hurdles when trained in France, where he acted on heavy going but lost his form in 2024; had wind surgery last summer and sported first-time blinkers on debut for new yard at Ffos Las one month ago but he jumped poorly on that chase debut (after 462 days off) and was pulled up; unraced beyond an extended 2m5f; something to prove but he is returned to hurdling.

runners.comment: Goes well on soft; should ensure that Haiti Couleurs does not have it all his own way
runners.name: LHomme Presse
runners.spotlight: Unraced here but a stalwart of the 3m+ chase division elsewhere; runner-up in contrasting styles in two Cheltenham races this season, rallying after losing his place at halfway in a Grade 3 handicap on reappearance, and leading until after the final fence in a four-runner Grade 2 two weeks ago; unraced on heavy but goes well on soft; should ensure that Haiti Couleurs does not have it all his own way.

runners.comment: Plenty to prove on soft ground and for stamina; he's also clear bottom on ratings
runners.name: Riskintheground
runners.spotlight: Won a 2m5f intermediate chase at Newton Abbot (2m5f, good to soft) in October but well held since; soft ground (let alone heavy) and stamina leave him with plenty to prove and he's also clear bottom on ratings.

runners.breeder: Dr V Simon Mrs V Simon & Mr N Simon
runners.comment: Amiss two runs back, otherwise superbly progressive; Welsh National was latest big win
runners.name: Haiti Couleurs
runners.spotlight: Superbly progressive novice last term, winning Cheltenham's NH Chase (3m6f, good to soft) and the Irish National (3m5f, soft to heavy); hurdles win here in November before something seemed amiss in a Grade 1 at Haydock 16 days later, but he bounced back from that with a sparkling display to dominate the Welsh National (3m6f) six weeks ago; that was another serious advance and he looks like earning his place in top Graded races after this.

runners.breeder: Jean-Pierre Dubois & Scea Haras Du Ma
runners.comment: Pulled up sole start on soft; plenty to find against two of today's rivals on the ratings
runners.name: Leave Of Absence
runners.spotlight: Lightly raced for his age and best form when pipped in a Grade 3 handicap at Ascot (3m, good to soft) on latest start; however, reportedly unsuited by the soft ground (his first race on it) when pulled up in a Listed novice chase at Cheltenham the time before and he has plenty to find against two of today's rivals on the ratings.

14:45.race_name: William Hill Game Spirit Chase (Grade 2) (GBB Race)

runners.comment: Landed this prize last year but incurs a bigger penalty this time; headgear fitted
runners.name: Master Chewy
runners.spotlight: Landed this prize last year but incurs a bigger penalty this time, making him worse off with runner-up Libberty Hunter, and concedes weight to some other notable rivals that include a very promising 5yo; outgunned by 12yo Edwardstone at Kempton most recently; chance of doing the Game Spirit double partly depends on how well he responds to first-time headgear.

runners.comment: Exciting youngster; impressive in Grade 1 at Sandown most recently; Arkle favourite
runners.name: Lulamba
runners.spotlight: Seems versatile as regards ground; leading juvenile hurdler prior to a smooth transition to fences, most recently impressive in Grade 1 novice at Sandown (1m7f) when taking overall strike-rate to 5-6; exciting youngster who is favourite for the Arkle and has any amount of further progress in him; trainer landed this prize with similarly esteemed novice chasers in 2012 and 2017; strongly respected.

runners.comment: Useful chaser but form dipped sharply last time and this is a difficult task
runners.name: Brookie
runners.spotlight: Useful chaser but is caught between a rock and a hard place, as he seems weighted to the hilt at handicap level currently and falls rather short of Graded standard in open company; form dipped sharply last time and this is a difficult task.

runners.comment: Two from two this term; better than ever and looks worth his place in this field
runners.name: Calico
runners.spotlight: Two from two this term, namely wins in useful handicaps at Cheltenham (2m) and Ascot (2m1f) in the autumn, both on good to soft; better than ever and has progressed to a mark of 154, so looks worth his place in this field; whether this 10yo is capable of recording a first success above Class 2 is another matter.

runners.comment: Good second in this contest 12 months ago; enters calculations back here
runners.name: Libberty Hunter
runners.spotlight: Acts on heavy ground; continued his progress with a good second to Master Chewy in this contest 12 months ago and he meets the winner on better terms in this rematch; subsequent form comprises two non-completions at Cheltenham and a remote fourth, albeit facing stiff assignment, in the Tingle Creek; return to this scenario puts him in calculations.

runners.comment: Has the worst chance at the weights but is progressive and could go well
runners.name: Meetmebythesea
runners.spotlight: Good effort in notable novice handicap on last hurdles attempt; unbeaten otherwise under rules and has taken well to fences, last time defying a penalty at Ayr (2m, heavy); has the worst chance at the weights upped in class but current rating isn't necessarily his ceiling; progressive and could go well.

runners.breeder: E A R L Haras Du Mondant Et Al
runners.comment: Very consistent; runner-up in two notable handicaps this term; rock-solid claims
runners.name: Saint Segal
runners.spotlight: Acts on soft ground; has become a very consistent handicap chaser; form figures this term read 1212, the second-place finishes behind progressive Thistle Ask in the Haldon Gold Cup at Exeter and Desert Orchid Chase at Kempton; better than ever, has won at Newbury and looks sure to run his race; rock-solid claims.

runners.breeder: E A R L Elevage Figerro & Hubert Favre
runners.comment: Progressive; registered a clearcut success in notable C&D handicap last time; respected
runners.name: Tutti Quanti
runners.spotlight: Acts on soft ground; progressive sort whose two attempts over C&D comprise a good effort, as a novice hurdler, on this card 12 months ago and clearcut success in notable handicap on last appearance (runner-up has franked the form since); an ideal type for this prize and warrants major respect despite carrying a big weight.

runners.breeder: N J Henderson And Mrs S A Aston
runners.comment: Dual winner of the Imperial Cup at Sandown; beaten twice off lower marks in this race
runners.name: Go Dante
runners.spotlight: Beaten twice off lower marks in this race (third in 2024, seventh in 2025) and seems unlikely to make it third time lucky; unbeaten at Sandown and likely to be more persuasive back there next month for a crack at an Imperial Cup hat-trick.

runners.comment: Faces a stiffer task in this field but is hard to dismiss, being 2-2 in C&D handicaps
runners.name: Bucephalus
runners.spotlight: Acts on heavy ground; front-runner who returned to form with cheekpieces fitted at Haydock most recently; back on career-high mark and faces a stiffer task in this field but is difficult to dismiss, being 2-2 in C&D handicaps; headgear retained.

runners.comment: Generally consistent until disappointing last time; his handicap form is over 2m4f
runners.name: Wellington Arch
runners.spotlight: Disappointing favourite at Windsor on return from layoff last time; generally consistent otherwise and may rebound but whether he can land this notable prize back at 2m is another matter; his handicap form, which includes Aintree win, is over 2m4f.

runners.breeder: E A R L Trinquet & M & O Trinquet
runners.comment: Useful on his day but isn't solid on this season's form; beaten twice in this contest
runners.name: Faivoir
runners.spotlight: Missed last term; useful on his day (County winner) but is into the veteran stage and not particularly solid on this season's form, for all that he was placed in the Greatwood; beaten twice in this contest (pulled up in 2023, fifth in 2024).

runners.comment: Novice hurdler; could be well treated and his yard has landed this race three times
runners.name: Un Sens A La Vie
runners.spotlight: Unexposed novice hurdler who posted a good effort behind the Supreme favourite on penultimate start; comfortably justified favouritism at Ludlow (2m, good to soft) latest, taking overall record to 4-7; this handicap debutant could be well treated and his stable has landed this race three times; interesting.

runners.comment: Ran creditably in the Lanzarote; may still have more to offer and remains of interest
runners.name: Lanesborough
runners.spotlight: Appears to act on any ground; ran creditably in the Lanzarote at Kempton (2m5f) four weeks ago when bidding for a hat-trick; seems versatile and scored easily over 2m at Doncaster on reappearance; may still have more to offer and remains of interest.

runners.comment: Back in top form, having won a valuable handicap at Windsor last time; not ruled out
runners.name: Hot Fuss
runners.spotlight: Has finished behind Tutti Quanti, All In You and Dance And Glance this term but may give them a fight as he's back in top form, having landed a valuable handicap at Windsor (2m, soft) most recently; 5lb penalty is in line with his future mark; not ruled out.

runners.breeder: L De Premont & P Bollart & X Bollart
runners.comment: Scored readily at Aintree in sole outing this season but the form may not be reliable
runners.name: Bubble Dubi
runners.spotlight: Missed last term but showed further progress to score readily at Aintree (2m1f, good to soft) in sole outing this season, albeit the form may not be reliable as several hurdles were omitted; on a stiffer mark and goes up sharply in class.

runners.comment: Scored comfortably at Sandown last time, reversing Ascot placings with Dance And Glance
runners.name: All In You
runners.spotlight: Overall record (Flat/hurdles) is 5-11; couple of very sound performances this term for new stable, nearly collaring Dance And Glance at Ascot (1m7f, soft) then reversing placings with that rival in comfortable fashion at Sandown (2m, good); open to further progress and has strong claims.

runners.comment: Interesting if the ground is heavy; successful in last four attempts on that surface
runners.name: Milldam
runners.spotlight: Steadily finding his form this season, respectable fifth to Hot Fuss at Windsor (soft) most recently; may be about to reach boiling point and he'll be particularly interesting if the ground is heavy, having been successful in last four attempts on that surface.

runners.comment: Close second in last season's Imperial Cup; form has dipped in three runs since
runners.name: Wreckless Eric
runners.spotlight: Steady progress at about 2m culminated in close second in last season's Imperial Cup; form has dipped in three subsequent starts but longer trips (2m4f/2m5f) perhaps contributed to two of those defeats; whether he's back on song remains to be seen.

runners.comment: Good effort in sole start this term; open to plenty of further improvement; big player
runners.name: Let It Rain
runners.spotlight: Acts on soft ground; 2-2 in bumpers, including Listed honours, and has a solid record (213) since switched to hurdles; only about half a length behind Dance And Glance and All In You at Ascot (1m7f; handicap debut) in sole start this term; this Skelton mare is open to plenty of further improvement; major contender.

runners.comment: Second-season hurdler who is proving consistent and should give his running; solid
runners.name: The Hardest Geezer
runners.spotlight: Second-season hurdler who is proving consistent; creditable fourth in competitive races won by Dance And Glance and Hot Fuss on last two starts; becoming a little exposed but again seems likely to give his running and is solid in that respect.

runners.comment: Folded tamely in the Windsor event won by Hot Fuss; has gained his wins in Class 4
runners.name: Poet Laureate
runners.spotlight: Folded tamely in the Windsor event won by Hot Fuss; still has low mileage over hurdles and may resume his progress at some stage but this seems a difficult assignment; has gained his wins in Class 4 (maiden/handicap).

runners.comment: Consistent sort; ties in with All In You on last two performances; should go well
runners.name: Dance And Glance
runners.spotlight: Just held on from strong-finishing All In You at Ascot (1m7f, soft) and was unable to confirm the placings, albeit far from discredited, at Sandown (2m, good); that rival has the upper hand with further progress plausible; however, this consistent sort should go well.

15:55.race_name: William Hill Cheltenham Non-Runner Money Back Novices' Limited Handicap Chase (GBB Race)

runners.comment: Won a match here last time, beating a smart rival; Grade 1 entry at Cheltenham
runners.name: Jigs Forge
runners.spotlight: Sixth in 2025 Albert Bartlett at Cheltenham; highly likely that the long odds-on favourite failed to give his running when this 7yo prevailed in a match over 2m6f here in December but it was no-nonsense stuff from the front and his first run over fences at Cheltenham was also encouraging (on soft); unexposed chaser who is in the Grade 1 Brown Advisory at Cheltenham; respected.

runners.breeder: R D & Mrs J S Chugg
runners.comment: Had some luck on his side when making a successful chase/stable debut at Ffos Las
runners.name: Pour Les Filles
runners.spotlight: Bought for £9,500 after going 1-6 over hurdles for Gordon Elliott; won by 15l in spite of jumping out to the right at Ffos Las (2m3f, soft; 4lb lower than today) but only two finished and the favourite would probably have won had he not come down; this task is tougher.

runners.comment: 2-3 over fences and the defeat looked too bad to be true; others still appeal more
runners.name: U Cant Be Serious
runners.spotlight: Showed a willing attitude to kick off his chasing career with two 2m3f handicap wins at Exeter (good to soft) and his Kempton run off this mark on Boxing Day looked too bad to be true; however, even if back on song, others may have his measure.

runners.breeder: Margaret Treacy On His Own Stables
runners.comment: 17-2 to defy this 5lb higher mark at Exeter but he unseated at the start
runners.name: Toss Of A Coin
runners.spotlight: Failed to complete his final two starts for Paul Nicholls but won narrowly after a wind operation on stable debut at Chepstow (2m7f, good to soft); 17-2 to defy this 5lb higher mark at Exeter but he unseated at the start in a race won by Silver Thorn.

runners.comment: Course winner; ran well at the weights in a novice chase at Cheltenham a month ago
runners.name: Knight Of Allen
runners.spotlight: This looks stronger than the 2m4f handicap chase he won here (good to soft; fine on soft) in December off 5lb lower but he ran well in the face of a stiff task at the weights at Cheltenham a month ago; each-way claims back up in trip.

runners.comment: 2-2 over fences, over 3m on heavy; firmly on the upgrade
runners.name: Itseemslikeit
runners.spotlight: 2-2 since sent chasing after a wind operation and he was well on top late on at Uttoxeter and Ffos Las (both 3m on heavy); 7lb higher than last time but firmly on the upgrade.

runners.comment: Just four got round at Exeter but the handicapper didn't go overboard with a 4lb rise
runners.name: Silver Thorn
runners.spotlight: Jumped poorly when tailed off in his first chase but has won his last two and had a bit in hand both times; only four got round last time at Exeter (3m, good to soft; has won on heavy) but the handicapper didn't go overboard with a 4lb rise.

runners.comment: Ran well to be fourth here in December when Captain Bellamy was runner-up
runners.name: Holloway Queen
runners.spotlight: Novice Listed winner over hurdles last winter (2m3f, heavy); unseated on chase debut but ran well to be fourth here (2m6f) in December this term when Captain Bellamy was runner-up; there were no excuses, other than jumping slightly to her right on occasions.

runners.comment: Only 3lb higher than for narrow defeat here at Christmas when he looked unlucky
runners.name: Captain Bellamy
runners.spotlight: Point/bumper winner who didn't hang about over hurdles; disappointing chase debut here in November but looked unlucky not to win over 2m6f here (good; effective on soft) over Christmas when a late rally narrowly failed; the winner of that race is unexposed; big player off just 3lb higher.

runners.comment: Yet to get anything going over fences (0-3) and this race is no easier
runners.name: Tune In A Box
runners.spotlight: A winner over hurdles at up to 3m but yet to get anything going over fences (0-3) and this is a tough race in which to put that right.

16:30.race_name: William Hill Racing Bet Builder Beacons (A Standard Open National Hunt Flat Race) (Listed) (GBB)

runners.comment: Fourth in a Listed race before a decisive win on soft at Wetherby; promising
runners.name: A Likeable Rogue
runners.spotlight: Both runs on soft under Brian Hughes; nice debut when fourth in a Listed race at Cheltenham and confirmed that promise at Wetherby where he was well on top in the closing stages; seems held in some regard and he's promising.

runners.comment: Prevailed in a sprint finish on debut and likely that he's better than that bare form
runners.name: Get Out Of My Way
runners.spotlight: 105,000euros 3yo and a brother to the stable's smart Tripoli Flyer; it wasn't a strong race that he won at Market Rasen (good to soft) but he justified market strength in a sprint finish; likely that he's better than that bare form.

runners.comment: Bought for £100,000 after defying a penalty with some comfort at Ballinrobe
runners.name: Governors Rock
runners.owner: Gummerson Martin W T Walsh & Williams
runners.spotlight: Won on good ground at Wexford before defying a penalty on soft at Ballinrobe where he quickened up smartly for a 5.5l verdict; previous and subsequent exploits of the runner-up gives that form substance; since recruited for £100,000; hard to dismiss.

runners.breeder: F Aimez Ms L Aimez & P Aimez
runners.comment: Closely matched with No Walkover on debut run; then won comfortably at Fontwell
runners.name: Half Hoping
runners.spotlight: Just missed out in a sustained duel with No Walkover at Chepstow (soft) before comfortably going one better at Fontwell (good to soft); it's been a bright start for the Gifford yard and he might well have a lot more to offer.

runners.comment: Debut second reads well and he's had a lengthy break since his Cheltenham demise
runners.name: Not Without Danger
runners.spotlight: Not beaten far by The Blue Room (since second to No Drama This End in a Grade 2 hurdle) on Ffos Las debut (good to soft) and subsequent absence suggests that all might not have been right with him when well beaten at Cheltenham (good); retains potential and a tongue-tie is added.

runners.breeder: R F And S D Knipe
runners.comment: 2-2 in bumpers, looking good last time; already useful and has the scope to keep improving
runners.name: No Walkover
runners.spotlight: The form of his Irish point second is strong and he's gone 2-2 under rules, nosing out Half Hoping at Chepstow (soft) before a more polished display at Aintree (good to soft) where he prevailed by 5l; already useful and has the scope to keep improving.

runners.comment: Fair fourth in Ascot Listed race but that run appeared to expose his limitations
runners.name: No Way Jay
runners.spotlight: Debut winner at Wincanton (good) but only fourth behind the smart Bass Hunter at Ascot (soft) and that run appeared to expose his limitations; still early days, admittedly, but others appeal more.

runners.comment: Impressive win at Warwick and has to be of strong interest
runners.name: Risky Obsession
runners.spotlight: Sold for 170,000euros after narrowly winning an Irish point and then fetched £190,000 at the David Maxwell dispersal sale in October; at 7-4, he made light work of market leader Smile John Boy at Warwick (good to soft) and has to be of strong interest.

runners.comment: Took a strong hold when put in his place by Risky Obsession when penalised at Warwick
runners.name: Smile John Boy
runners.spotlight: Defied market weakness to make all at Hereford (good) and he took a strong hold when put in his place by Risky Obsession when penalised at Warwick (good to soft; though Callum Pritchard did claim 3lb); could improve on that form if giving himself a chance by settling but the winner did look good.

runners.comment: Easily won a race for newcomers at Wincanton and the ground was testing that day
runners.name: Trojan Tale
runners.owner: R H J Martin And Anna Harris
runners.spotlight: Didn't go unbacked when far too good for a well-touted favourite in a bumper for newcomers at Wincanton (heavy); today's conditions clearly won't bother him and Harry Cobden is booked; commands respect.

runners.comment: Has finished behind A Likeable Rogue and No Walkover in his last two races
runners.name: Wonder Flying
runners.spotlight: Wouldn't be the obvious answer having finished behind A Likeable Rogue and No Walkover in his last two races; has to step up and by some margin.

12:40.race_name: Oddschecker Free Bets Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)

runners.comment: Pulled up and tailed off in his two maidens on soft ground; huge odds both times
runners.name: Blazing Gaden
runners.spotlight: Pulled up and tailed off in his two maidens on soft ground; huge odds both times.

runners.comment: His fifth here wasn't a bad run given his absence but likely best watched for now
runners.name: Chasing Glance
runners.spotlight: Won a maiden point by 15l on debut in April 2023 but not seen again until two months ago when beaten 17l behind the useful Moneygarrow in a 2m5f maiden here (fitted in a tongue-tie following wind surgery); that wasn't a bad run given his absence but likely best watched for now.

runners.comment: British bumper winner; last seen 12 months ago when pulled up in a French hurdle
runners.name: Full Force Gale
runners.spotlight: Ffos Las bumper winner (good to soft) but then only sixth at Wetherby; last seen 12 months ago when pulled up in a French hurdle; has questions to answer.

runners.comment: Smart form in defeat over hurdles; should win this en route to something a lot better
runners.name: Just Golden
runners.owner: The Late John Hales And Miss L Hales
runners.spotlight: Bumper winner on soft; beaten favourite in his three runs over hurdles but has performed to a smart level, last time going down narrowly in a Cheltenham maiden (2m4f, good); should win this en route to something a lot better; the tongue-tie is new.

runners.breeder: E A R L Du Loisir
runners.comment: 2nd in an Irish point; had a break and wind surgery since a 25l defeat at Cheltenham
runners.name: Leader Crik
runners.spotlight: Clear second in his Irish point and was bought for £160,000 soon after; finished well behind in a Cheltenham novice (2m4f, good to soft; 10-1) but that was three months ago and he's since had a wind operation; better expected.

runners.comment: Back from an absence when third behind two good horses at Exeter; can improve
runners.name: Limerick Star
runners.spotlight: 5l off a talented winner in an Irish point in April 2024; not seen again until a month ago when a 12l third at Exeter (good to soft); that form looks good as the winner is well thought of (has Cheltenham options) and the second has bolted up since; respected over this longer trip.

runners.comment: Has shown fair ability but finished tired and tailed off at Lingfield on Thursday
runners.name: Matthias
runners.spotlight: Runner-up to a good horse in his second bumper; back from a long absence when a well-held third in a Chepstow novice and finished tired and tailed off at Lingfield on Thursday.

runners.comment: Second in a point; given every chance when fourth over 2m3f at Fontwell
runners.name: Mr Finch
runners.spotlight: Bought for £70,000 after his second in an Irish point in October, the form of which has been franked under rules; given every chance at Fontwell (2m3f, soft; 11-4) but didn't see it out as well as the principals; a repeat of that is unlikely to see him home here but he's entitled to improve.

runners.comment: May need a tad more if he's to thwart Just Golden but he's probably that one's main threat
runners.name: Piping Rock
runners.spotlight: Third in an Irish point; made a bright start under rules, though ran better at Windsor (2m4f, good to soft) than last time at Wincanton (2m4f, soft); may need a tad more if he's to thwart Just Golden but he's probably that one's main threat.

runners.comment: Bought for £155,000 after winning an Irish point by 2l about this time last year
runners.name: Vanderflier
runners.spotlight: Bought for £155,000 after winning an Irish point by 2l and the third finished runner-up in a Leopardstown bumper over Christmas; has been absent for 12 months so market confidence would be welcomed.

13:15.race_name: Get The Best Odds With Oddschecker Warwick Mares' Hurdle (Listed Race) (GBB Race)

runners.comment: A mare on a mission when last seen in the autumn of 2024, completing a four-timer
runners.name: Flying Fortune
runners.spotlight: A mare on a mission when last seen in the autumn of 2024, completing a four-timer in a 2m3f Grade 2 on soft ground at Chepstow; wouldn't be without hope if resuming in the same order and stable can get them fit at home.

runners.comment: Chasing this season; held by Jubilee Alpha on last season's clashes with that mare
runners.name: Hollygrove Cha Cha
runners.spotlight: Grade 2 winner as a novice but is held by Jubilee Alpha on last season's clashes with that mare; this campaign started very promisingly over fences and was let down by her jumping when below par last time at Windsor; can't afford to be at all off her game on this return to hurdling if she's to scare Jubilee Alpha.

runners.comment: Did well as a novice and in this season's three defeats she's posted her best RPRs
runners.name: Jubilee Alpha
runners.spotlight: Three wins as a novice included two at Listed level, beating Hollygrove Cha Cha and La Pinsonniere in the process; weighted to confirm places with both those rivals and in this season's three defeats she's posted her best RPRs; should prove difficult to beat.

runners.breeder: Elms Bloodstock & Miss A Gibson Fleming
runners.comment: Bang in form but faces a different calibre of opposition here and on unfavourable terms
runners.name: Analiese
runners.spotlight: An improving mare who has made all for her recent 2m4f handicap wins at Uttoxeter (soft) and Aintree (good to soft); however, faces a different calibre of opposition here and on unfavourable terms.

runners.comment: Absent since April when beaten by Jubilee Alpha; 3lb worse off with that rival here
runners.name: La Pinsonniere
runners.spotlight: Not out of the first two in her five British starts (on good and good to soft; handled softer in France) but was outpointed by Jubilee Alpha in the latest at Cheltenham last April (2m4f, good; second run in cheekpieces); 3lb worse off the winner and this mare lacks a recent run.

13:50.race_name: Bet Smarter With Oddschecker Kingmaker Novices' Chase (Grade 2) (GBB Race)

runners.comment: Impressed in 2m3f Ascot Grade 2 in December and is now 2-2 over fences
runners.name: Steel Ally
runners.spotlight: Very useful hurdler with 2-2 strike-rate over fences this season, the latter win gained by 9l in Grade 2 novice at Ascot (2m3f, soft) in December; should be fine back at 2m and ought to be a very tough nut to crack.

runners.comment: Made stylish headway from the rear before winning Kempton Grade 2 over Christmas
runners.name: Mambonumberfive
runners.spotlight: Rapidly progressive 5yo who won Grade 2 novice at Kempton (2m, good) over Christmas, having made stylish headway from the rear, and is now 3-3 over fences; had placed form over hurdles on heavy ground when based in France and could still be anything.

runners.comment: Won on chasing debut but behind Mambonumberfive on next outing; improvement needed
runners.name: Mirabad
runners.spotlight: Jumped well when causing 14-1 surprise in four-runner beginners' chase at Exeter (2m1f, good to soft) in December but was behind Mambonumberfive when third in Kempton Grade 2 (2m, good) later that month and unseated rider when last in action.

14:25.race_name: Unibet Middle Distance Series Veterans' Handicap Chase (Series Qualifier)

runners.comment: Smart in his prime; back from long absence with two pretty good efforts this season
runners.name: Knappers Hill
runners.owner: Chris & Giles Barber And P J Vogt
runners.spotlight: Smart hurder/chaser in his prime; absent more than two years after Grade 2 novice chase win in autumn 2023 but returned with two pretty good efforts this season (2m5f/3m) and has possibiites in his first veterans' chase; copes well with soft ground; unraced on heavy.

runners.comment: Won this off 1lb lower a year ago and returned to form at Sandown last month
runners.name: Le Milos
runners.spotlight: Returned to form with creditable second in valuable veterans' final at Sandown (3m, good) last month and remains only 1lb higher than when winning this race readily by 6l a year ago (soft ground); major player, and his appeal will increase if the ground turns heavy.

runners.comment: Ran well for a long way in good Ascot handicap last month but remains on long losing run
runners.name: Fugitif
runners.spotlight: Quirky customer who is without a win since December 2023 and has become frustrating; that said, he ran well for a long way in a valuable Ascot handicap (2m5f, soft) three weeks ago and is another 4lb lower here.

runners.comment: Looked out of sorts on first two outings this season; revival needed
runners.name: Outlaw Peter
runners.owner: The Stewart Family Dench Ferguson & Mason
runners.spotlight: Lightly raced since bagging two good prizes towards end of 2023-24 season and has looked out of sorts on both outings this term; will be suited by the trip/ground here but needs a revival.

runners.breeder: Little Lodge Farm & Mr & Mrs Twr Chugg
runners.comment: Absent since good run last May but last season's C&D win came after a break; a possible
runners.name: Guard Your Dreams
runners.spotlight: Absent since clear second of 14 at Uttoxeter (3m, good) last May but it's worth remembering his narrow C&D (good) win in October 2024 came after a layoff; versatile regarding ground and current mark is workable; a possible.

runners.comment: Kept on for third in good Cheltenham handicap last month, and today's ground will suit
runners.name: Grandeur dAme
runners.spotlight: Has rather mixed record over last couple of years but gave good account when keeping-on third in valuable Cheltenham handicap (2m4f, good) on New Year's Day and will be suited by the slower ground here.

runners.comment: Below form on latest outing (wore blinkers) and the slow ground here is a worry
runners.name: Lord Baddesley
runners.spotlight: Easily won three-runner contest at Newbury (2m4f, good) on seasonal debut (first run after wind op) and subsequent third of four at Ascot (2m5f, good; jumped left) was respectable; below that form when tried in blinkers (now removed) last time, though, and the slow ground here is a worry.

15:00.race_name: Weatherbys Cheltenham Festival Betting Guide Jane Seymour Mares' Novices' Hurdle (Grade 2) (GBB)

runners.comment: Won 3m Grade 3 hurdle comfortably in December; hard to beat if as good over this trip
runners.name: Good Girl Kathleen
runners.spotlight: May have gained an advantage by sticking to the inside rail in Grade 3 novice at Cork (3m, soft to heavy) in December but she was firmly in control of that race from a long way out and is now 2-3 over hurdles; will be hard to beat if she's as good over this shorter trip.

runners.comment: Pipped Park Princess in Haydock Listed race in December; 5lb worse off with her here
runners.name: Supreme Malinas
runners.spotlight: Listed bumper winner who is 2-2 over hurdles this season; kept on well to pip Park Princess in Haydock Listed race (2m3f, good to soft) in December but was probably second best on merit there and has to concede 5lb to her old rival here.

runners.comment: Placed in Haydock Listed race in December and may still have a bigger run in her
runners.name: A Path To Ronda
runners.spotlight: Bumper/2m6f maiden hurdle winner; just behind Supreme Malinas and Park Princess when third in Haydock Listed race (2m3f, good to soft) just before Christmas but could still have a bigger run in her if suited by today's slower ground.

runners.comment: Won by clear margins over C&D and at Ayr on last two starts; has more on her plate here
runners.name: Dream Shadow
runners.owner: M Doocey S Doocey & P J Doocey
runners.spotlight: Useful in bumpers last season and 2-3 over hurdles this term, the wins gained by clear margins over C&D (good to soft) and at Ayr (2m4f, heavy); has more on her plate in this higher grade, though.

runners.comment: Made all in good-ground Windsor handicap last month but needs further improvement here
runners.name: Easy Love
runners.spotlight: Bounced back from a poor performance to make all in Windsor handicap (2m4f, good) on New Year's Day and is now 2-4 over hurdles; probably has more improvement to come but others in this line-up already have stronger form, and she's untested on ground slower than good to soft.

runners.breeder: Earl De Cordelles & Earl La Dariole
runners.comment: 2m5f course winner in December; still unexposed but needs a big step forward today
runners.name: Indannya
runners.spotlight: Built upon promising rules debut when winning 2m5f novice here (good to soft) on New Year's Eve; remains very unexposed but needs to take another big step forward on today's slower ground.

runners.comment: Smart bumper performer who has made a good start to her hurdling career; good chance
runners.name: Kingston Queen
runners.spotlight: Listed bumper winner who was placed in Grade 2 bumper at last season's Aintree festival; far too good for recent Grade 2 winner Kripticjim when scoring by 7l on seasonal/hurdle debut at Chepstow (2m3f, good to soft) in November and probably paid a price for trying to match strides with very exciting Old Park Star when well-held third at Cheltenham (2m1f, good to soft) in December; back up in trip here; leading contender.

runners.comment: Forced to work hard at skinny odds last time; better judged on previous Listed second
runners.name: Park Princess
runners.spotlight: Left it late before leading close home to justify skinny odds under determined ride at Fontwell (2m1f, soft) last month but she's probably better judged on her very close second to Supreme Malinas in Listed grade at Haydock (2m3f, good to soft) in December, where a slow jump at the final flight proved coslty; ought to make her presence felt.

runners.comment: Won Newbury handicap by 5l in December and is now 3-3 this season; likely contender
runners.name: White Noise
runners.spotlight: Progressive mare who won Newbury handicap (2m, good to soft; first-time tongue-tie) by 5l just after Christmas and is now 3-3 over hurdles this season; has good chance at the weights on this return to novice company, assuming she copes well with the slower ground.

15:35.race_name: Oddschecker Cheltenham Free Bets Handicap Hurdle

runners.comment: 2-4 over hurdles; slightly disappointing on latest outing but remains of interest
runners.name: Le Yacht
runners.spotlight: 2-4 over hurdles, the latter win gained in Doncaster handicap (2m, soft) in November; slightly disappointing when upped to 2m3f at Haydock in December but may still have potential and remains of interest.

runners.comment: Not at best in latest chase but reverts to hurdling on a lower mark; a possible
runners.name: Homme dUn Soir
runners.owner: Jb Harper And Cavalry And Guards
runners.spotlight: Ended 2025 with a below-par chase run but his second on seasonal debut at Huntingdon (2m, good) in November was a good effort; reverts to hurdling on a lower mark and seems versatile ground-wise; shortlisted.

runners.comment: Just held on to score in first-time cheekpices in December; slower ground a worry here
runners.name: Cornish Storm
runners.spotlight: Just held on to score in first-time cheekpieces at Taunton (2m3f, good) in December and now 2-11 over hurdles; only 3lb higher here but the slower ground is probably not in his favour.

runners.comment: Irish bumper winner; yet to strike form for new stable but should be okay on the ground
runners.name: Ufouria
runners.spotlight: Irish bumper winner (yielding to soft) in early 2025; safely held on both hurdling starts for new stable this season (novice/handicap) but recent 5lb drop helps, and she ought to cope better with today's ground than some of these.

runners.comment: Second at Punchestown festival last spring; might have needed last month's low-key run
runners.name: Almuhit
runners.spotlight: Commendable second of 25 in valuable series final at Punchestown festival (2m3f, yielding) on stable debut last spring and subsequently won twice on the Flat; made low-key reappearance this month and would probably prefer better ground than this but still considered.

runners.comment: Gained his novice wins on good ground and was tailed off in recent soft-ground handicap
runners.name: Service Minimum
runners.spotlight: Won two good-ground novice hurdles (2m/2m4f) in early part of this season but has found things tougher in handicaps since, and was tailed off when encountering soft ground last month.

runners.comment: Back from three-month break; gained all hurdle wins over 2m4f+ on good ground
runners.name: Supreme Yeats
runners.owner: The Old Stag Racing Sy Partnership
runners.spotlight: Now 2lb lower than when placed in big-field Chepstow handicap (2m3f, good) in the autumn but his three hurdle wins were gained over 2m4f+ on good ground, and it's questionable whether today's trip-and-ground combination will suit on his first start for three months; blinkers removed.

runners.comment: Always behind at Newbury in December, after a layoff; wants much better ground
runners.name: Get The Value
runners.spotlight: Won twice from the front on good ground last spring but was given a break after a poor run in the summer; always behind when reappearing at Newbury in December, as was the case the only time he raced on soft ground.

16:10.race_name: Best Cheltenham Odds With Oddschecker Handicap Hurdle

runners.comment: Capable handicapper in Ireland and could be an interesting addition for new yard
runners.name: Last Kingdom
runners.spotlight: Initially disappointing over hurdles in Ireland but came good last spring, winning a handicap at Fairyhouse (2m, soft to heavy) and went in again at Listowel in September (good to yielding; first-time cheekpieces); one of his subsequent runs was okay, though looked a non-stayer at 2m4f in the other; could still be an interesting addition for his new yard; cheekpieces now left off.

runners.comment: Chasing this season; novice hurdle form (3-3) reads well and could be on a good mark
runners.name: Fingle Bridge
runners.spotlight: Chasing this season; eyecatching behind Lulamba first time out before finishing alone after Phantomofthepoints had come down at Uttoxeter; wasn't overly fluent that day, nor when third at Ayr, and now defends an unbeaten record over hurdles (3-3); his novice form has worked out well and potentially on a good mark for this handicap debut; unraced over this far but should stay.

runners.comment: Fell on chase debut and worryingly below par on last month's return to hurdling
runners.name: Phantomofthepoints
runners.owner: Mrs Jo Tracey K Alexander P&S Bryceland
runners.spotlight: 2m/3m winner over hurdles; reappearance was encouraging but fell over fences next time and wasn't at his best back in this discipline at Haydock (3m, good to soft); nothing wrong with this mark if he can get himself back on track; ground fine.

runners.comment: Thoroughly exposed but back in good form and latest run looks even better now
runners.name: Luttrell Lad
runners.spotlight: November's Exeter win looked unlikely but he stayed on much the best over 2m2f on good to soft; not beaten far off this 6lb higher mark at Sandown (2m4f, good) when close up behind Henri The Second who won easily back there last weekend; thoroughly exposed but enters the equation for sure; has won on heavy.

runners.comment: Chasing this season; won three novice hurdles last term and highly tried in his defeats
runners.name: Junker dAllier
runners.spotlight: Won three novice hurdles last season and was highly tried in his defeats; it's been a mixed start over fences (after wind surgery), let down by his jumping on handicap debut latest; probably worthy of this mark and he's back over hurdles.

runners.comment: 3-6 as a hurdler and won't mind getting back on a slower surface; considered
runners.name: Believitanducan
runners.spotlight: Failed to fire at Kempton last time (2m5f, good) but seemed suited by the step up to 2m4f (soft) the run before when the front two pulled clear; 3-6 as a hurdler and won't mind getting back on a slower surface; considered.

runners.comment: Threatening to lose his way; plenty depends on what effect first-time cheekpieces have
runners.name: Champagne Twist
runners.spotlight: Looked one to follow as a novice when winning the always-competitive EBF Final at Sandown but hasn't kicked on as expected and has pulled up over fences and hurdles the last twice; plenty depends on what effect first-time cheekpieces have.

runners.comment: Recent defeats (since winning yard debut) have been in stronger races than this
runners.name: Prince Zaltar
runners.spotlight: 3m winner over fences in Ireland and made a winning debut for this yard over hurdles in September (2m5f, good to soft); his subsequent defeats, all over 3m and divided between hurdles and fences, suggest his current mark is on the high side.

16:45.race_name: Total Metal Recovery Mares' Open National Hunt Flat Race (Category 1 Elimination) (GBB Race)

runners.breeder: E A R L Elevage Des Loges
runners.comment: Debut winner; stopped very quickly and pulled up in a Listed race; better than that
runners.name: Analitheia
runners.spotlight: Won well at the expense of 14 rivals at Exeter (soft) and surely failed to give her running in a Listed race at Market Rasen (good to soft), where she was pulled up after stopping very quickly; couldn't rule out.

runners.comment: Overcame distinct signs of greenness to narrowly deny a subsequent winner at Wetherby
runners.name: Popton Point
runners.spotlight: Overcame distinct signs of greenness to narrowly deny a subsequent winner at Wetherby (soft) and, although penalised, this doesn't look a strong race.

runners.comment: Trainer-owned newcomer; third foal out of a bumper winner who is well related
runners.name: Atlantic Blue
runners.spotlight: Trainer-owned newcomer; third foal out of a bumper winner who was runner-up in a 2m3f hurdle and is a half-sister to high-class 2m chaser Kadarann; one to note in the market.

runners.comment: 20,000euros 3yo and a half-sister to last weekend's Sandown chase winner Pic Roc
runners.name: Jotas Gold
runners.spotlight: 20,000euros 3yo; sixth foal; half-sister to winners Pic Roc (useful 2m3f hurdle/2m7f chase) and A Distant Place (point/2m3f hurdle); dam French 10.5f winner; interesting pedigree and the market should be instructive.

runners.comment: Went 1-5 in Irish points and changed hands for 20,000euros in December
runners.name: Port And Brandy
runners.spotlight: Went 1-5 in Irish points and changed hands for 20,000euros in December; there could be more to come from her under rules.

runners.comment: Bought for £80,000 after finishing second in an Irish point in October (yielding to soft)
runners.name: Vrheligonne
runners.spotlight: Bought for £80,000 after finishing second in an Irish point in October (yielding to soft) and the winner has shown some ability in defeat for Joe Tizzard; could easily be very competitive.

runners.comment: Newcomer; her trainer's bumper runners have earned respect in the last two years
runners.name: Gentora
runners.spotlight: 9,000euros yearling; fifth foal; sister to useful 2m-3m hurdle/chase winner Masters Legacy; dam unraced half-sister to useful 2m-3m hurdle/chase winner Qianshan Leader; her trainer's bumper runners have earned respect in the last two years.

runners.breeder: S C E A De La Vallee De LOrne
runners.comment: Second foal; dam well held in AQPS race/over hurdles in France
runners.name: Mega Etoile
runners.spotlight: Second foal; dam well held in AQPS race/over hurdles in France; stable has had bumper winners this season; market needs checking.

12:35.race_name: Always Gamble Responsibly At BetMGM Apprentice Handicap

runners.comment: Unexposed colt and a possible improver back up in trip on handicap debut; watch market
runners.name: Thankfully Simmy
runners.spotlight: Finished down the field in three novice events, but he was only beaten 3l when fourth of seven at Newcastle (5f) in December; still early days for this Mehmas colt and he's a possible improver back up in trip on handicap debut; one to keep an eye on.

runners.comment: Regressive form in novice events and was in rear on handicap debut at Kempton last month
runners.name: Euphonia
runners.spotlight: Regressive form in novice events and was never involved when eighth of 11 on handicap debut at Kempton (6f) last month; made some late gains in that race but she needs to find more on this return to Tapeta.

runners.comment: Well backed when close third on yesterday's handicap debut at Wolverhampton
runners.name: Marra Donna
runners.spotlight: Well backed prior to yesterday's handicap debut at Wolverhampton (7f, Tapeta), where he was a close third; raced wide early and there can be optimism he's capable of winning from this mark; has shown promise on Polytrack.

runners.comment: Justified favouritism on handicap debut at Southwell; up 6lb but he's a major player again
runners.name: Al Najashi
runners.spotlight: Well held in three qualifying runs, but he found improvement on handicap debut when justifying strong support at Southwell (6f, Tapeta; 5-4 favourite) last month; up 6lb but that was a comfortable success and he could have a lot more to offer; big player.

runners.comment: Sole win was in a Carlisle novice last May and he's 0-8 in handicaps; others preferred
runners.name: Mister Moet
runners.spotlight: Sole win was in a Carlisle novice (6f, good to soft) last May; runner-up twice on AW this winter but he was disappointing at Wolverhampton last time and is now 0-8 in handicaps; others preferred.

runners.comment: Seven-race maiden who has not really progressed and was beaten 7l in a C&D handicap latest
runners.name: Real Gold
runners.spotlight: Seven-race maiden who has not really progressed and was beaten 7l when fourth in a C&D handicap (25-1) two weeks ago; down the list.

runners.comment: Reached the frame in three of her four qualifying runs; needs close look on handicap debut
runners.name: Mad Dash
runners.spotlight: Reached the frame in her first three starts, including when runner-up behind the unbeaten Desert Treasure at Windsor (5f, good); faded into sixth of ten in a Newcastle novice last month, but it's still early days for this well-bred filly and she needs a close look on handicap debut.

runners.comment: Exposed filly but she won at Southwell and should go well again back in a handicap
runners.name: Filly Foden
runners.spotlight: Off the mark at the 16th attempt when landing Southwell novice (5f, Tapeta) last Friday; that was a narrow success but she's had some close calls in handicaps this winter and this is only fourth run for current yard; should be in the thick of things again.

runners.comment: 0-6 but she has a solid record and looks interesting on this drop back in trip
runners.name: Havana Jag
runners.owner: Hold My Beer D Cunha M Broughton
runners.spotlight: 0-6 but he's been placed three times and was only beaten 2l when fifth in a Chelmsford maiden (6f) last month; has shaped as though this return to 5f could suit and she could make a bold bid back in a handicap.

runners.comment: Has been gelded but he needs improvement back in trip on his return; visor added
runners.name: Enter Sandman
runners.spotlight: Yet to build on his debut promise and was a well-held sixth of 12 on nursery debut at Kempton (6f, Polytrack) in October; gelded since but he needs improvement back in trip on his reappearance; visor added.

runners.comment: Mark is falling but she's 0-6 and needs a transformation on this drop back in trip
runners.name: Baileys Ontherocks
runners.owner: Baileys Horse Feeds (F H Nash Ltd)
runners.spotlight: Six-race maiden who has not progressed and was ninth of ten in Wolverhampton nursery (6f) in December; dropped another 3lb but she needs a transformation on this drop back in trip.

runners.comment: Chelmsford winner who had a near miss over C&D last time; respected
runners.name: Rosieisme Darling
runners.spotlight: Won a Chelmsford nursery (5f, Polytrack) in December and she resumed her progress back in trip with a near miss over C&D three weeks ago; there wasn't much separating the first four but that was a bold bid and she's only 1lb higher here; respected.

runners.comment: Tailed off in al three runs and she needs lots of improvement on her handicap debut
runners.name: Epsom Ali
runners.spotlight: Tailed off at massive prices in three 6f runs in the autumn, with a best RPR of only 28; now goes handicapping after a break but she needs lots of improvement on this drop in trip.

13:45.race_name: Read Meg Nicholls' Blog At betmgm.co.uk Handicap

runners.comment: Won on debut at Newcastle last February but he's been disappointing since and is now 1-9
runners.name: Nordic Norm
runners.spotlight: Won on debut at Newcastle last February but he became disappointing for Karl Burke; hasn't been with current yard for long but he was beaten 9l at Chelmsford (1m, Polytrack) last month and is now 1-9; passed over.

runners.comment: Won at Windsor last May but he's generally struggled since; has something to prove
runners.name: Kingkeer
runners.spotlight: Won a Windsor handicap (11.4f, good to firm) last May, but he's generally struggled since and was never involved on stable debut over C&D last month; has something to prove and he's still 3lb higher than for his win.

runners.comment: Five-time course winner who is on dangerous mark and looks interesting back up in trip
runners.name: Tadreeb
runners.spotlight: His last five wins have been at this track (7f) and he's effective at this trip; hasn't made a serious impact this winter but he finished well to snatch third behind an improver here (7f) last time; continues to edge down the weights and he could be a big factor back up in trip

runners.comment: Ended long losing run with a clearcut win over C&D last Saturday; big player again up 5lb
runners.name: Way To Dubai
runners.spotlight: 7yo who ended a long losing run with a clearcut success over C&D (9-2) last Saturday; up 5lb but he remains well handicapped on old form and and that recent win wasn't from out of the blue; key player.

runners.comment: Held in bid for four-timer at Wolverhampton on Monday; needs to find more in new headgear
runners.name: Latin
runners.spotlight: Has won five times since September but he couldn't pose a threat in his bid for a four-timer at Wolverhampton (8.6f) on Monday; wasn't beaten far in that race but he needs to find some extra spark in new headgear.

runners.comment: Good second in hat-trick bid at Wolverhampton and his last win was over C&D; respected
runners.name: Francesi
runners.spotlight: Made it 3-7 for Tony Carroll when completing a double over C&D last month and he ran another good race when runner-up from wide draw at Wolverhampton last time; still looks on a workable mark and he's an interesting contender back at this track.

runners.comment: Has been out of sorts in his last seven runs and is untried at this trip; opposable
runners.name: Elouises Prince
runners.spotlight: Both wins came over 5f at Wolverhampton in the autumn of 2024; well treated on old form but he's lost his way since his last win and is untried at this trip; opposable.

runners.comment: Infrequent Flat winner these days but arrives on the back of two placed efforts; e-w shout
runners.name: Enthused
runners.spotlight: Doesn't win too often on the Flat these days but he has been placed on his last two starts, chasing home Seraphic at Chelmsford four weeks ago (1m2f); each-way claims again.

runners.comment: Two good runs since a visor went on last month; 4lb rise for latest win not insurmountable
runners.name: Noss Mayo
runners.spotlight: Two good runs since the visor went on last month, finishing second at Chelmsford before justifying favouritism in good style at Newcastle two weeks ago; up 4lb in a better race but on the right path now.

runners.comment: 0-7 but best run came last January when 2nd over C&D; now 6lb lower; not discounted
runners.name: Lightningboltzoom
runners.spotlight: Low-mileage 5yo; best run from his seven starts came when second of 11 to The Bay Warrior over C&D last January; struggled since but he is now 6lb lower and last month's stable debut/return from ten-month absence should have sharpened him up.

runners.comment: Two good runs at Kempon following wind/gelding ops; more to come; strong contender
runners.name: Chancellor
runners.spotlight: Returned from wind and gelding operations to land a 7f handicap at Kempton in November; confirmed himself an improved performer when a keeping-on second in a 1m Listed event at Kempton in December (Tyrrhenian Sea 3l back in third); still has untapped potential and he's a strong contender.

runners.comment: Two-time AW Listed winner; absent 12 months; no surprise to see him return with a bang
runners.name: Dear My Friend
runners.owner: Middleham Park Racing XXV & Michael Lai
runners.spotlight: Useful on turf but better on AW, winning four of his six starts including twice at Listed level (won the corresponding race when it was run at Lingfield in 2024); off the track for a year but still more appealing than many.

runners.comment: Good 2nd in France last time but enjoyed the run of the race; others look more persuasive
runners.name: Skylight Brochard
runners.spotlight: The winner of four of his 27 races in France and capable of useful form; only narrowly denied by the red-hot favourite in a conditions event at Cagnes-Sur-Mer (1m, AW) a fortnight ago but he was allowed to dictate steady fractions and was seen to maximum effect; does have a Listed win on his CV (6.5f, AW; March 2024) but might find a few of these stronger.

runners.comment: Progressive handicapper last year; work to do with Witch Hunter on latest run
runners.name: Storm Star
runners.spotlight: Three 1m wins at Newcastle last year, including the 1m handicap on Good Friday; disappointing finishing effort when sixth behind Witch Hunter back there three weeks ago; needs to raise his game upped in class.

runners.comment: Admirable performer for whom conditions hold no terrors; this looks a tough task though
runners.name: Two Tempting
runners.spotlight: He has been a fine servant to connections and added wins eight and nine to his tally in 2025, the latest a 1m handicap at Kempton in November; ran as well as he ever has when second to an upwardly mobile 4yo over C&D five weeks ago but even that effort will need bettering in this field.

runners.comment: Won this race (run at Lingfield) last year; close 2nd over 1m2f latest; in the mix again
runners.name: Tyrrhenian Sea
runners.spotlight: Two Listed wins at Lingfield, including this race 12 months ago; may have needed the run when 3l behind Chancellor at Kempton in December and went desperately close over 1m2f later that month; shouldn't be too far away once more.

runners.comment: Held by Chancellor on Kempton form but won well at Newcastle latest; contender
runners.name: Witch Hunter
runners.spotlight: He was conceding 3lb (1lb weight for age) to Chancellor when third in a hot 7f handicap at Kempton in November; back to something approaching his very best when winning a 1m handicap at Newcastle three weeks ago, confirming himself fully effective at the trip; shouldn't be far away.

20:00.race_name: Always Gamble Responsibly At BetMGM Handicap

runners.comment: Poor form thus far but has a good pedigree and now drops into a 0-55; may do better
runners.name: Life After Love
runners.spotlight: Poor form in her four starts, including when 50-1 for her handicap debut at Wolverhampton last month; bred to be better than this level and too soon to write her off.

runners.comment: Yet to shine in handicaps but still early days; drops back in trip with headgear left off
runners.name: Mythical Night
runners.spotlight: No better than sixth in her two handicaps but only beaten 2.5l on the former occasion and the latest wasn't as bad as the distance beaten suggests; cheekpieces left off now back at 5f; Sean Levey a positive booking for the stable.

runners.comment: Second, albeit a remote one, at Wolverhampton 11 days ago (6f); more required back at 5f
runners.name: He Bangs The Drums
runners.owner: Middleham Park Racing Lxii & Partner I
runners.spotlight: Gained his first placing when second to an easy winner at Wolverhampton 11 days ago (6f); more will be needed back at 5f but this is uncompetitive.

runners.comment: Lowly RPRs in three runs but she has hinted at ability & can step forward now handicapping
runners.name: Blueaway
runners.spotlight: She has recorded modest RPRs in her three novice/maiden runs but there has been clear promise, notably over 6f here last time; she has been found a weak race for her handicap debut and could take a good step forward.

runners.comment: 2nd on handicap debut in December but that form is modest; well held latest; new headgear
runners.name: Calabrian Soldato
runners.spotlight: Improved for the switch to handicaps when second of seven at Chelmsford in December (5f; cheekpieces on for the first time); stopped quickly at Wolverhampton (6f) 11 days ago; return to 5f can help and blinkers now replace the cheekpieces.

runners.comment: Poor form in five starts, including both handicaps; gelded since latest; lots to prove
runners.name: Sands Of Seve
runners.spotlight: Failed to land a gamble on his handicap/AW debut in November; again well beaten tried in cheekpieces at Chelmsford in December; hopes appear to rest on a gelding operation having a positive effect.

runners.comment: No better for handicapping when 9th of 10 over 6f here last month; now tongue tied
runners.name: Rai Rogers
runners.spotlight: No improvement for the switch to handicaps here three weeks ago (6f); drop to 5f/addition of a tongue-tie not enough to tempt.

20:30.race_name: Midnite Are Upping The Betting Game Handicap

runners.comment: Losing run stands at 21 but banging at the door for his new yard; down in trip/class here
runners.name: True Promise
runners.spotlight: Losing run stands at 21 but there have been several good efforts in defeat along the way and he has been placed in four of his five runs for his new stable; should be involved again back down in trip and class.

runners.comment: Of major interest judged on emphatic C&D win in December; excuses both starts since
runners.name: Ay Gee Ell
runners.spotlight: Looked transformed by a visor when running away with a C&D handicap in December; went off hard over 6f next time and wasn't discredited, while his latest C&D third came when his usual tongue-tie was absent; it is back today and he can make a bold bid.

runners.comment: Third behind Popular Dream over C&D last month; fair mark on 2025 best; each-way shout
runners.name: Brazilian Belle
runners.spotlight: Two turf wins to her name; has shown promise on AW, including when third to Popular Dream over C&D 32 days ago; each-way shout.

runners.comment: Runner-up over C&D on his last two starts; should give it another good go from the front
runners.name: Birkenhead
runners.spotlight: Useful front-runner on his day and he has finished runner-up over C&D on his last two starts; unlikely to be let loose on the lead with other pace influences on show but he can't be discounted.

runners.comment: Not at best on last two starts but this should be run to suit and he is on a fair mark
runners.name: Popular Dream
runners.spotlight: Not at his best on his last two starts but this four-time C&D winner should get a strong pace to aim at today and he is not handicapped out of things; more appealing than many.

runners.comment: Well held at big odds in two runs back from a year off; check the betting
runners.name: Kitaab
runners.spotlight: Two low-key runs (at big odds) since returning from a year on the sidelines; down in class today and worth a market check, for all 6f may suit best.

runners.comment: Prolific 9yo who arrives in top form; conditions to suit but this a step back up in class
runners.name: Street Life
runners.spotlight: Multiple winner who kicked off his year with a C&D win (his fifth) 18 days ago; two good runs at Wolverhampton have followed; needs a bit extra now back up in class.

runners.comment: Ran okay over C&D in December but usually slowly away and one to tread carefully with
runners.name: Dapperling
runners.spotlight: Habitual slow-starter; late headway into fourth behind Ay Gee Ell over C&D in December but less good over 6f on her last two starts; others look stronger for win purposes.

runners.comment: Back to his last winning but well beaten over 5f on his last two start; opposable
runners.name: Neptune Legend
runners.spotlight: Won a Wolverhampton 0-60 (6f) off this mark in November and performed with credit on his next two starts; well beaten on his last two starts though and he has finished unplaced in seven runs at 5f.
